name: gridpoint-fix
description: Markers for fixed gridpoint conditions (velocity / displacement fixity). Validated against 'plot item create gridpoint-fix ?' in FLAC2D 9.0.
notes: This item draws FIX-CONDITION markers. For continuous coloring by gridpoint field values (displacement, velocity, pore-pressure, temperature) use 'plot item create zone contour <attribute>' — the zone contour interpolates from gridpoint data.
Pore-pressure fixity has a separate item type: 'plot item create pp-fix'.
Probe live with 'plot item create gridpoint-fix ?' and 'plot item create gridpoint-fix <kw> ?'.
FLAC3D 9.7 keyword set adds clip, cut and transparency to the FLAC2D 9.0 set; otherwise identical. Verified against FLAC3D 9.7 via '?' probing (2026-08-13).

keywords.description: Show or hide the gridpoint-fix item.
keywords.name: active

keywords.description: Configure the color list (clear / global / label).
keywords.name: color-list

keywords.description: Deformation factor — exaggerate displacement of marker positions.
keywords.name: def-fac

keywords.description: Hide markers attached to null zones.
keywords.name: hide-null

keywords.description: Legend sub-keywords (active, count, heading, label, etc.).
keywords.name: legend

keywords.description: Line-style sub-options for the fix markers.
keywords.name: line

keywords.description: Filter which fix markers are drawn (range elements).
keywords.name: range

examples.command: plot item create gridpoint-fix active on legend active on
examples.description: Overlay markers at gridpoints with fixed velocity components. Use case: Show gridpoint velocity-fix markers
